title: Optimising cancer aftercare – do we need new approaches? – A survey on the importance of cancer aftercare amongst patients with ovarian, fallopian tube or peritoneal cancer (Expression XV / NOGGO S31)
summary:
Die Expression XV-Studie ist eine Umfragestudie, die untersucht, wie Patientinnen
mit einem Eierstock-, Eileiter- oder Bauchfellkrebs ihre Nachsorge erleben. Dabei
soll erfasst werden, wie die Nachsorge derzeit in Deutschland umgesetzt wird,
welche Fachrichtungen daran beteiligt sind und wie zufrieden die Patientinnen mit
der Betreuung sind. Die Ergebnisse sollen helfen, die Nachsorge besser an die
Bedürfnisse der Patientinnen anzupassen und langfristig zu verbessern.
conditions: This is a national survey involving women with ovarian, fallopian tube or peritoneal cancer who are currently undergoing follow-up care. The aim of the study is to evaluate the current state of care for patients with ovarian cancer as part of their follow-up care in Germany. The focus is on the question of the extent to which existing guideline recommendations are being implemented and whether follow-up care is provided in accordance with guidelines, in a structured manner and across the board. Main hypothesis: The majority of patients in Germany receive follow-up care in accordance with guidelines.  Translated with DeepL.com (free version)
